name: Christmas Jazz Trio
spec: Guitar, upright bass and drums with brushes
alt: A drum kit, an upright bass, a piano and microphone stands set up on an empty stage.
blurb: Most of your guests will know the music from A Charlie Brown Christmas within the first few notes. This trio plays those songs, along with Christmas standards and a few jazz standards that have nothing to do with Christmas, and everyone can easily talk over it. You can book the trio for a cocktail hour, for drinks and dinner, or for your whole holiday party.
